one_sentence: Harbour City did not play worse after minute 53: their passing, shape and attacking tempo stayed the same, and the swing to Northgate came from a short run of their own carries and two blocked shots, which is within normal match noise.

Team B threat per minute 0.073 before vs 0.067 after; team A rose from 0.042 to 0.063
Net momentum over minutes 53-60 (+0.216) ranks 21st of 87 eight-minute windows, so the swing is not unusual
Team B mean position when the ball is in its own half 49.5 before vs 48.8 after, so no defensive shape change
B7 passes fell from 10.7% of B's passes before 53 to 9.5% in minutes 53-60, and the bigger drop only starts after minute 61

Player fatigue: B7 speed fell from 11.76 to 11.23 km/h, the same pattern as B3 (11.11 to 10.38) and most of the squad, so it is a match-wide effect and not specific to one player
Player behaviour change: B7 still made 4 of 42 team passes in minutes 53-60 (9.5% share vs 10.7% before); the larger drop-off comes after minute 61 and coincides with his substitution
Team tactical change: B shape and ball-location-adjusted position unchanged; B pass completion unchanged
